name: Nomad Orc
desc: Orcs of the open steppes and badlands: tireless travelers who live off the land.

traits.name: Nomadic Training
traits.desc: You gain proficiency in either the Animal Handling or Survival skill.

traits.name: Nomadic Stride
traits.desc: Your Speed increases by 5 feet. In addition, nonmagical Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.

traits.name: Nomadic Resilience
traits.desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage.
